name: GitLab
description: Access projects, issues, merge requests, and CI/CD workflows through GitLab's official MCP server or API.
notes: Supports GitLab.com through either the official MCP server (beta) with OAuth or the API with a personal access token. MCP access must be allowed for the top-level group. For GitLab Self-Managed, edit the MCP URL and use host-specific OAuth endpoints.

auth.credentialHelp: Create a token in [GitLab access token settings](https://gitlab.com/-/user_settings/personal_access_tokens) with the api scope.

installHint: Prefer the OAuth MCP connection. The GitLab MCP server supports OAuth 2.0 with dynamic client registration using the mcp scope. For GitLab Self-Managed, edit the URL to https://<your-instance>/api/v4/mcp and make sure MCP server access is enabled for the instance.
